ModMetaData.name: 鼠鼠诅咒 Ratkin Curses [1.5/1.6/1.7]
ModMetaData.author: Feng Xinzi, RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
1.7本地适配保留本项目独立Wounded诅咒、世界状态和Def，不合并其他诅咒项目。实际使用Anomaly的GrayPall天气和肉兽音效，1.7明确依赖Anomaly。验证范围见UPGRADE-1.7.md。 Local1.7 adaptation retains this standalone Wounded curse and requires Anomaly for its actual GrayPall weather/sound. See UPGRADE-1.7.md for validation scope. 鼠鼠异常里的诅咒现在可以设置为永久游戏状态了，并且不是随机的
The curses in Ratkin Anomaly+ can now be set as permanent game states, and are no longer random
